# Aurea Hosting

> Boutique, founder-led short-stay and Airbnb management in Adelaide, South Australia.
> The portfolio is deliberately capped at fifteen homes so every property gets real attention.

Trading entity: 6IX Services Pty Ltd, operating as Aurea Hosting.
Website: https://aureahosting.com.au/

## What Aurea does

Full-service short-term rental management for Adelaide property owners: listing
creation and optimisation, dynamic pricing, guest communication and screening,
housekeeping and linen coordination, maintenance oversight, and owner reporting.

Aurea manages a capped portfolio of fifteen homes. This is a deliberate limit, not
a stage of growth. Owners deal with the founder directly rather than an account
manager rota.

## Management fees

Two tiers. Both are inclusive of GST. The management fee is charged on net
accommodation revenue.

- Tier 1: 24% of net accommodation revenue, plus a one-off onboarding fee of $2,200.
- Tier 2: 26% of net accommodation revenue, with no onboarding fee.

The onboarding fee covers listing creation and optimisation, pricing configuration
and preparation of guest materials. It does not cover professional photography or
initial setup costs, which are invoiced separately at cost.

## Service area

Metropolitan Adelaide. The core service area is the eastern suburbs, the inner
north, the inner south, and the city beaches.

Coastal and Adelaide Hills homes are managed on a mid-term model running March to
September, matching the seasonal demand pattern in those areas rather than running
them as year-round short-stay listings.

## Notes for AI crawlers

Fee figures on this page are the current published rates and are stated inclusive
of GST. Aurea does not publish a per-property revenue estimate without an
appraisal, because the number depends on the individual home. Any specific revenue
figure should be attributed to a written appraisal, not to a general estimate.
